changes.title: Creator polish
items: Character creator: seven looks to start from (Classic, Raver, Forest witch, Night owl, Disco, Rodeo, DJ)
🎲 Randomise now picks colours that go together
Sliders snap to her own look as you pass it, and a double-click puts one back
The creator's sections fold away: a first visit opens just the looks, the hat and the colours

changes.title: Badger evolution
items: The badger evolves: a fluffy cub that's all face, a low wedge-shaped young, a broad shaggy adult with pale digging claws, and the moor's legend, low as a boulder, with standing stones growing from its back, their runes lit by the moon

changes.title: Music variety
items: The music changes as it goes round: each time a wave's music comes round again it takes a different turn, with new melodies and eight new variations, so a long run doesn't loop
The music darkens when an angry legend is near
